title: Backend - Performance & caching for graph generation (Mongo aggregation + cache keys)

requirements: Add caching for computed graph results keyed by orgId + date range + effective settings
Replace per-item nested loops with Mongo aggregation for co-occurrence counts (reduce memory/time)
Cap correlation workload (top entities/instruments, min data points, concurrency limit)
Add structured timing logs for each phase (co-occurrence, correlation, buildGraph)
acceptance: Graph generation uses cache on repeated calls for same inputs
Co-occurrence computation no longer loads all matching documents into JS memory
